notes.text: If you're aiming to get a full Monster Library, then make sure that you find both the Prototype and Custom Wind Shears before moving on.
If you need a bit of extra cash, see the beginning of the next section, where you can find a Third Key that you can sell.

Except for weapons / armor / caps / belts, which are assumed as obvious missables as they are replaced by stronger versions, there are two pieces of equipment that you need to buy now if you ever plan on getting them, as they're only available in Asia. Once you finish Kuihai Tower, you'll never be able to get them again, so make sure to buy as many as you want/need NOW. These items are... - Brigand Earrings (Shanghai, Huayuan) (I recommend purchasing 6) - Pirate Earrings (Shanghai, Huayuan) (I recommend purchasing 5)

As I mentioned before, Mr. Zhen is now hosting pit fights! Just visit the bar
and go behind on the curtain at the top of the screen and talk to him. It costs
300 Cash to fight, and you'll have to fight 10 consecutive battles, with no
chance to heal between battles. There are 12 sets of enemies; the order is
random, and you'll only have to fight 10 of the 12 sets of enemies listed in
the Enemy Formations section above.

You'll want to fight with Yuri, as you get a special prize once you've beaten
all 10. Two-thirds of the enemy groups listed are pretty easy, however, these
four may give you trouble:


   Yamaraja: Wind
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
He's decently strong against physical attacks, so make sure that you're able to
cast Wind Shear with your Tornado Fusion to try and take him out quickly.


   Li Li
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
She's a pain just like before. Make sure you have something that prevents
Paralysis, or you're in for a rough battle. Other than that, some normal
physical attacks while fused should take her out rather quickly, especially if
you have the Mind's Eye equipped.


   Prototype Wind Shear
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
Unlike the weaklings from the beginning of the game, this guy means serious
business, and is as tough as a boss. It has the ability to inflict Judgment
Ring anomalies, but also casts Flaming Arm of Death, which can Silence you and
keep you from being able to use Fusion. Make sure that you heal every other
round with Thera Seeds to keep your HP up, because he can decimate of TON of it
in just two rounds, and stay in the Man Dragon Fusion to keep casting Flash
Flood in the rounds you're not healing. If you have the Mind's Eye equipped and
you're pretty successful at it, do that instead, as you'll inflict more damage.


   Custom Wind Shear
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
As with the Prototype Wind Shear, I hope you have the Pocket Watch equipped,
otherwise you're going to have a heck of a time hitting your ring. He is also
just as strong as his counterpart, easily of boss difficulty. Make sure that
you heal every other round with Thera Seeds to keep your HP up, because he can
decimate of TON of it in just two rounds, and stay in the Inferno Fusion to
keep casting Fireball in the rounds you're not healing. If you have the Mind's
Eye equipped and you're pretty successful at it, do that instead, as you'll
inflict more damage.

Taking into consideration all that the plethora of enemies here can do to you
(Paralysis, Ring anomalies, and Silence), I recommend having the following
setup:

       .———————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————.
       |                           Yuri [19]                           |
       |                                                               |
       |===============================================================|
       |                          Hand Needle                          |
       |                        Studded Harness                        |
       |                                                               |
       |   RosewoodBracelet  OR  Zodiac Bracelet ¯¯\  OR  Mind's Eye   |
       |      Bell Bracelet  OR  Cosmic Bracelet __/¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   |
       |                         Pocket Watch                          |
       |                                                               |
       |                          Man Dragon                           |
       |                            Inferno                            |
       |                            Tornado                            |
       '———————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————'

If you're comfortable with the Judgment Ring, even with anomalies on it, then I
recommend keeping the Mind's Eye on in place of one of the Bracelets. Paralysis
and Silence can easily be cured with an item. If you want to play it ultra-
safe, then don't worry about the Mind's Eye.

Once you've defeated a set of 10 enemies with Yuri, you'll receive
[_5000 CASH_], as well as a memento for Yuri, [_ANNE'S CROSS_].

  NOTE     If you're aiming to get a full Monster Library, then make sure that
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   you find both the Prototype and Custom Wind Shears before moving on.

Make sure to SAVE before entering!
